name: ThinkPad
description: Fan, keyboard backlight and logo light controls with CPU temperature and saved profiles.

settings.label: Profile applied on start
settings.description: Profile to restore when ThinkPad starts. Leave blank to use the last profile applied in the panel.

settings.label: Apply the profile on start
settings.description: Push the active profile to the hardware as soon as the plugin attaches, so the machine comes up the way you left it.

settings.label: Custom logo image
settings.description: Absolute path to a PNG to use in the panel header instead of the built-in wordmark.

settings.label: Poll interval (ms)
settings.description: How often fan speed and light levels are re-read from the hardware.

settings.label: Overheat warning
settings.description: Warn when the CPU gets hot, which matters most while a low fan level is pinned.

settings.label: Notify on write errors
settings.description: Raise a desktop notification when the hardware refuses a change, usually because permissions have not been set up yet.
